The '''Spacer's Rest''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on [[Wroona/Legends|Wroona]]. [[Platt Okeefe/Legends|Platt Okeefe]] occasionally bribed Customs Officer [[Allia (customs official)|Allia]] with drinks from the cantina.
